summary: Tokyo Lifestyle filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report) disclosing board approval of 13,503,648 new ordinary shares issued two ways: a JPY58,838,000 cash subscription by Representative Director Mei Kanayama for 1,396,755 shares, and a JPY510,000,000 debt-to-equity swap with Tokushin G.K. extinguishing its loan. Pricing benchmark was US$0.274 per share (US$2.74 per ADS). Kanayama recused; auditors found no favorable-issuance issue. Settlement is set for September 29, 2026, warranting dilution and related-party governance scrutiny.
